description:
CATCH THE THOUGHT BEFORE IT’S GONE.
Accurate, fast, and private speech-to-text notes for iPhone and Apple Watch—made for the moments when you cannot stop to type.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start from what is closest. Use the app, Apple Watch, a widget, Control Center, or Shortcuts. On iPhone, you can also say “Siri, start recording with Teika.”
• Talk until you are done. Teika keeps listening when you pause to think and stops when you tap again.
• Paste it now or find it later. Every transcription is copied to your clipboard and saved in a searchable library on your iPhone.

PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE TRANSCRIPTION
Teika runs its speech recognition model on your iPhone. Your recordings are not uploaded to a Teika server, and your speech is not sent to an AI service. After setup, transcription works in Airplane Mode.

Record on your paired Apple Watch and the clip is transferred to your nearby iPhone for local transcription.

ONE-TIME SETUP
Teika needs a one-time speech-model download of about 0.5 GB. Before it starts, Teika shows the size and provider and asks for your permission.

Free. No account, ads, subscription, or tracking.

OPTIONAL TASK INTEGRATIONS
Turn new voice notes into tasks in Apple Reminders or Things. Choose your destination in Notes Settings. Task exports are off until you enable them. Only new notes are exported; existing notes and later edits stay in Teika. Exported text may sync through your Reminders account or Things Cloud.
name: Teika: Voice to Text Notes
subtitle: Private offline dictation
reviewNotes: No account is required. On first launch choose Set Up Transcription, then approve the one-time 0.5 GB model download. Record with two taps; transcription runs on the iPhone. Saved notes are editable from the notes library. A paired Apple Watch records after iPhone setup and queues recordings while disconnected. In Notes > Settings, Add notes to defaults to Off. Apple Reminders requests permission and offers list and No date/Today choices; Things (installed separately) supports Inbox/Today. Only new notes are exported. If delivery is unconfirmed, check the destination before retrying to avoid duplicates.
